option_relations.rationale: The option 'Radiation-induced solitary rectal ulcer' is clinically equivalent to 'Radiation-induced rectal ulcer (radiation proctopathy)' as the solitary nature is a descriptor of the ulcer, not a distinct disease.
Solitary rectal ulcer syndrome is a distinct condition not necessarily caused by radiation, whereas the vignette points to radiation as the etiology.
The option 'Radiation-induced rectal ulcer (radiation proctopathy)' is identical to the provided leaf.

Radiation-induced proctitis with ulceration is clinically equivalent to radiation-induced rectal ulcer, as proctitis refers to inflammation of the rectum, and ulceration is a severe form of this inflammation, often leading to an ulcer.
